name: Chin Hin Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Chin Hin Group Berhad 与 EC Excel Wire Holdings 签订谅解备忘录，由后者供应 wire mesh 和 steel bar，并持续处置 Chin Hin Group Property Berhad 的股份。年内未披露产能扩张、新业务线或合约订单方面的具体进展。
overview_en: In 2026, Chin Hin Group Berhad entered into a memorandum of understanding with EC Excel Wire Holdings for the supply of wire mesh and steel bars, and continued to dispose of shares in Chin Hin Group Property Berhad. No specific progress on capacity expansion, new business lines or contract orders was disclosed during the year.

segments.name: 制造 wire mesh
segments.note: 今年与 EC Excel Wire Holdings 签订谅解备忘录，由后者供应 wire mesh 和 steel bar，年内未有实质进展。
segments.note_en: This year the company entered into a memorandum of understanding with EC Excel Wire Holdings for the supply of wire mesh and steel bars, with no material development during the year.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告与 EC Excel Wire Holdings 的谅解备忘录截至 2026 年 11 月 26 日没有重大进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that there was no material development on the memorandum of understanding with EC Excel Wire Holdings as of 26 November 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告与 EC Excel Wire Holdings 的谅解备忘录截至 2026 年 8 月 27 日没有重大进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that there was no material development on the memorandum of understanding with EC Excel Wire Holdings as of 27 August 2026.

actions.text: 公告与 EC Excel Wire Holdings 的谅解备忘录截至 2026 年 5 月 21 日没有重大进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that there was no material development on the memorandum of understanding with EC Excel Wire Holdings as of 21 May 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告与 EC Excel Wire Holdings 的谅解备忘录截至 2026 年 2 月 26 日没有重大进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that there was no material development on the memorandum of understanding with EC Excel Wire Holdings as of 26 February 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 EC Excel Wire Holdings Sdn. Bhd. 签订谅解备忘录，由后者供应 welded mesh、wire mesh 及 steel bar，并给予其优先供应权，备忘录有效期 3 年并可按年自动续期。
actions.text_en: Entered into a memorandum of understanding with EC Excel Wire Holdings Sdn. Bhd. for the latter to supply welded mesh, wire mesh and steel bars, granting it a first right of refusal, valid for 3 years and automatically renewable annually.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年持续处置 Chin Hin Group Property Berhad 股份，并与 Universiti Sains Malaysia 的谅解备忘录维持无重大进展状态。
segments.note_en: This year the group continued to dispose of shares in Chin Hin Group Property Berhad, while the memorandum of understanding with Universiti Sains Malaysia remained without material development.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 于 2026 年 1 月 7 日至 11 月 25 日期间通过场外交易处置 Chin Hin Group Property Berhad 共 46,590,000 股普通股，占其已发行股本 3.36%，平均每股 RM1.09，总代价 RM50,785,100。
actions.text_en: Disposed of a total of 46,590,000 ordinary shares of Chin Hin Group Property Berhad via off-market transactions between 7 January 2026 and 25 November 2026, representing 3.36% of its issued share capital, at an average of RM1.09 per share for a total considera…
